RimHex.HexStarChallengeDef030.label: Crossing hunters
RimHex.HexStarChallengeDef030.description: Threat: A feeder protects linked enemies. Answer: Kill or control the feeder, or interrupt power with actual damage. Reward: Linked enemies lose defense and take 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Cost: Ignoring power leaves up to 20% damage reduction. Arrangement: Protected target; Left then right impacts. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
